proofBoundary: build/report parity matrix only; parse-only/build-only/preflight-only/probe-only entries are not runtime proof; not real-model-runtime proof; not full trtexec replacement proof; not package-consumer-runtime proof
ownerEvidenceRequiredForPromotion: real TensorRtExec or OnnxToEngine build report hash
YoloVision or Classification Passed=True in a real run log
clean external package-consumer-runtime proof for release package claims

entries.proofBoundary: ONNX path selection is build input only; it is not runtime proof.
entries.notes: External ONNX path or embedded identity model when omitted.

entries.proofBoundary: Serialized engine output is build artifact evidence only.
entries.notes: Serialized engine output or dry-run report path.

entries.proofBoundary: Engine readback metadata and SHA256 are dependency/preflight evidence; bounded one-float-input enqueue/readback can run but cannot promote real-model or package-consumer proof without expected output evidence.
entries.notes: Records engine metadata/SHA256 and may execute bounded runtime output for compatible float engines.

entries.proofBoundary: Profile shape application is build evidence until a real sample run validates the binding.
entries.notes: Dynamic profile shape triplets.

entries.proofBoundary: Shape alias normalization does not prove runtime output correctness.
entries.notes: Seeds profile triplet when explicit min/opt/max are absent.

entries.proofBoundary: FP16 builder flag is not proof of model accuracy or runtime package consumption.
entries.notes: Applied when runtime reaches builder config.

entries.proofBoundary: Conditional precision availability is not promoted without compatible host runtime logs.
entries.notes: Parsed and reported; availability depends on TensorRT line.

entries.proofBoundary: Parse/report-only precision intent cannot be claimed as implemented TensorRT behavior.
entries.notes: Parsed, normalized, and reported as precision intent; capability and model proof are not promoted.

entries.proofBoundary: INT8/calibrator ownership remains blocked until safe calibrator lifecycle and real calibration proof exist.
entries.notes: Parsed/report-only until safe calibration ownership is implemented.

entries.proofBoundary: Workspace limit application is not runtime output proof.
entries.notes: Active builder workspace limit with unit parsing.

entries.proofBoundary: Memory pool set/get readback proves builder-config acceptance only; it is not runtime output, model accuracy, or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: Known trtexec pool tokens are mapped to TensorRtMemoryPoolType, applied during a real build, and read back through TensorRtBuilderConfig.GetMemoryPoolLimit. Dry-run and load-engine remain parse-only.

entries.proofBoundary: Tactic source intent is report evidence only.
entries.notes: Recorded for parity; does not claim tactic execution proof.

entries.proofBoundary: Timing cache import and its SHA256 are build-cache evidence only; they are not model accuracy, runtime execution, or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: The typed TensorRtTimingCache owner imports the caller-provided file during build and records size/SHA256.

entries.proofBoundary: Timing cache export and its SHA256 are build-cache evidence only; they are not model accuracy, runtime execution, or package-consumer proof.
entries.notes: The typed TensorRtTimingCache owner serializes the cache after a successful build and records output size/SHA256.

entries.proofBoundary: Plugin path normalization does not load/register/deregister plugin libraries and is not plugin runtime proof.
entries.notes: Repeated plugin aliases are normalized into the plugin path list; no plugin library is loaded, registered, deregistered, or serialized by this stage.

entries.proofBoundary: Profile verbosity reports are not enqueue/profile runtime proof for external models.
entries.notes: Normalized to none, layer_names_only, or detailed.

entries.proofBoundary: Dry run and preview never parse/build/execute; they cannot promote proof.
entries.notes: No runtime probing, ONNX parsing, engine build, or inference.

entries.proofBoundary: Sparsity intent is not model-level sparse execution proof.
entries.notes: Parsed and reported for parity.

entries.proofBoundary: Refit intent is not refit lifecycle proof.
entries.notes: Refit intent recorded; no refit lifecycle promoted.

entries.proofBoundary: Debug/refit/weight-streaming parse output is not runtime ownership or tensor output proof.
entries.notes: Debug/refit/weight-streaming intent is recorded in reports and ParseOnlyOptions only; no runtime ownership or output proof is promoted.

entries.proofBoundary: Packaging intent is not public package or post-publish proof.
entries.notes: Packaging intent only.

entries.proofBoundary: Device/DLA intent requires compatible host runtime proof before promotion.
entries.notes: Device and DLA intent recorded; runtime proof requires model-specific run.

entries.proofBoundary: Independent execution contexts, CUDA streams, host driver threads, event polling, graph capture/launch, transfer suppression, warmup, minimum iteration/duration scheduling, idle gaps, timing-average windows, and percentile statistics prove bounded scheduler execution only. noDataTransfers suppresses output readback and cannot prove correctness; none of these mechanics proves package consumption.
entries.notes: Compatible float engines report requested/applied values, per-context rounds, threads, graph fallback reason, raw GPU timing samples, and averaged timing windows. CUDA graph is applied only when every context captures and instantiates successfully.

entries.proofBoundary: Official device-side launch-to-compute delay is not implemented and remains an explicit ParseOnlyOption.
entries.notes: CPU Thread.Sleep is not used as a substitute for official --sleepTime semantics.

entries.proofBoundary: Input artifact paths can feed bounded generic runtime, but loading an input file is not output correctness or package-consumer-runtime proof.
entries.notes: Input mapping is normalized for reportability and must be paired with expected output, real runner logs, and hashes before promotion.

entries.proofBoundary: A dump-output request is not tensor correctness proof without validated output JSON, run log, and owner evidence.
entries.notes: Records output dump intent and keeps build-only/external ONNX paths non-proof.

entries.proofBoundary: Raw binding dump files are bounded artifacts only and must not be treated as public raw binding handle exposure or runtime correctness proof.
entries.notes: Raw binding artifacts remain audit support until real model logs and hashes validate them.

entries.proofBoundary: Output, timing, and profile exports are supporting files only unless a real sample runner validates them with owner evidence.
entries.notes: Synthetic runtime can write minimal evidence; external ONNX build-only writes non-proof boundaries.
